prompt: Stage 2-5, level 5. Your 2-star ranged carry has held a single sword component since stage 1, and you took a second sword at the carousel. Two components on one champion combine into a completed item. Who gets the second sword?
explanation:
Drop the second sword on the carry that already holds the first and the two combine into a completed damage item, worth far more than two loose swords. Giving it to the caster instead leaves two champions each holding half an item, and half an item is a small stat, not an item. The tank is worse again: a sword adds attack damage, and the tank's job is to be hit, not to hit.

The habit: when a component drops, look first for the champion already holding one.
principle: Two components on the same champion make an item; one each on two champions makes nothing.
commonMistake: Spreading components one per unit 'so everyone gets something' and never completing an item.
hint: Which unit on the board is already holding a component, and what happens when a second one lands on it?
